title: Aqua block outline
description: Makes the block outline when you look at the block light blue.
body:
# 🧊 Aqua Block Outline

Changes the block selection outline to a clean **Aqua color**.

## ✨ Features

* 🧊 Aqua block outline
* 👀 Easier visibility
* 🚀 No FPS impact

> Clean, simple, and subtle.
